text: Hello, neighbours! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so I spend a lot of time among apple trees. In spring the blossoms hum with my bees, and that is why the apples come in so sweet. Plant a few trees close together and the pollination works wonders. Come autumn, I'll share honey and apples with anyone who asks.
speaker: ada

text: Um... hi. The pond is quiet in the mornings, and I like that. When the wind is light, the water ripples in a way that sounds almost like a slow melody. I come here to play music, because the pond never minds a wrong note.
speaker: bo
